sentinels.if_pattern: agent boundary sentinel work is described as Fortran-derived parallel semantics, stdlib surface, or target projection evidence
sentinels.wrong_boundary: repository authoring gate is confused with language/compiler capability
sentinels.why_wrong: Fortran-derived data parallelism is a Pergyra language competitiveness axis; sentinel rows are repository guardrails for future generated code
sentinels.turn_toward: docs/168_fortran_parallel_evidence.md for data-parallel facts, or this JSON catalog for agent boundary warnings

sentinels.if_pattern: backend, verifier, or self-hosted code rereads source text or AST to recover a semantic fact
sentinels.wrong_boundary: source recovery after typed fact ownership
sentinels.why_wrong: semantic truth must be owned by MIR, AIR, DAG/type metadata, ABI/layout, or an explicit verifier fact
sentinels.turn_toward: the typed owner fact, or a fail-closed verifier when the fact is missing

sentinels.if_pattern: C or LLVM backend accepts a missing fact through i32, empty string, zero, or best-effort fallback
sentinels.wrong_boundary: backend compatibility path becomes hidden semantics
sentinels.why_wrong: backend output must consume MIR or ABI facts, not guess a valid program shape
sentinels.turn_toward: typed MIR/ABI fact plus fail-closed diagnostic
sentinels.owner: MIR/ABI fact owner and backend parity owner

sentinels.if_pattern: a helper only renames a local standard operation or hides a one-off branch
sentinels.why_wrong: helpers are allowed only when they name a real owner responsibility or repeated contract
sentinels.turn_toward: inline code or owner-named responsibility module

sentinels.if_pattern: a generic *_helpers file grows because an owner is too large
sentinels.wrong_boundary: responsibility split postponed behind a bucket name
sentinels.why_wrong: large owners should split by responsibility, not by helper dumping ground

sentinels.if_pattern: main.pgy parses JSON, text, or emitted artifacts to reconstruct compiler stage facts
sentinels.wrong_boundary: self-hosted entrypoint becomes a second fact owner
sentinels.why_wrong: entrypoints should orchestrate; shared stage facts belong in self-hosted owner libraries
sentinels.turn_toward: src/self_hosted owner module for the fact type

sentinels.if_pattern: a runtime call appears on a path documented as erased or hot without a retain/materialize fact
sentinels.why_wrong: runtime materialization is acceptable only when evidence says retain or materialize
sentinels.turn_toward: AIR/MIR materialization fact and visible artifact evidence
sentinels.owner: AIR abstraction compression and runtime materialization owner

sentinels.if_pattern: parallel, async, or worker code passes growable Array, Slice, List, Queue, Set, or HashMap storage by raw pointer
sentinels.why_wrong: rehash or grow plus concurrent read can become undefined behavior
sentinels.turn_toward: channel/result handoff, explicit copy, or pinned read-only view owner
sentinels.owner: memory concurrency and SEA lane owner

sentinels.if_pattern: ExecutionLaneFact or lane selection is reused as proof that a loop can be vectorized, fused, or projected
sentinels.wrong_boundary: execution safety confused with data independence
sentinels.why_wrong: SEA says where work may run; data-parallel evidence says how it may be split
sentinels.owner: SEA owner plus future data-parallel evidence owner

sentinels.if_pattern: backend code hardcodes layout, bit order, endianness, stride, or address-space policy
sentinels.why_wrong: layout and reinterpretation must be explicit facts or world-boundary conversions
sentinels.turn_toward: ABI/layout row, ArrayLayoutFact, or explicit bits/reinterpret boundary
sentinels.owner: ABI/layout owner and target projection owner

sentinels.if_pattern: security or runtime audit path emits free-text logs for machine-audited events
sentinels.why_wrong: security events need stable machine fields for audit and red-team replay
sentinels.turn_toward: structured diagnostic or structured log event

sentinels.if_pattern: shell script computes semantic truth that a self-hosted tool claims to own
sentinels.wrong_boundary: test oracle hides a second implementation
sentinels.why_wrong: parity scripts may compare artifacts, but the self-hosted owner must compute the semantic verdict
sentinels.turn_toward: self-hosted tool JSON output plus negative fixture

sentinels.if_pattern: a broad CI target is run or required for an isolated owner edit without impact classification
sentinels.why_wrong: isolated owner edits should run narrow gates first and broaden only on real dependency evidence
